agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements, granting a full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for their management and supervision.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a cash dividend of Rp180 per share, totaling Rp2,951,640,000,000 or 52.30% of the 2025 net profit, with the remainder allocated to retained earnings.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint a Public Accountant from Purwantono, Sungkoro & Surja to audit the 2026 Financial Statements.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) and BPS Regulation No. 7 of 2025.
